header: A feature next to a customer quote
bodytext: Rich text on one side; on the other a quote with a name, a role and a portrait. Use it when a claim needs a person to back it. When the proof is a measured number, use the outcome numbers instead.
quote_text: We changed the theme a week before launch. Not one template was touched, and every page still passed the contrast check.
author: Mara Lindqvist
